body.message:
Hi,

Thank you for the clarification.

I understand that refunds are usually returned to the original payment method. However, in my email I provided my bank account details and understood that the deposit would be refunded to that account.

Could you please clarify why I was asked to provide bank details if the refund could only be sent back to the original payment method?

Also, please confirm the last 4 digits of the card/account used for the original payment so I can verify the refund destination.

Thank you.
